A little vinegar works in a pinch, but fresh lime or lemon tastes best.

recipes.storage: Press cling film directly onto the surface and refrigerate for up to 1 day; the top may darken slightly — just stir it in.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Lemon Butter and Greens
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned salmon fillets with a garlicky lemon–butter and dill sauce, served on quickly cooked broccoli and wilted spinach.

steps.title: Dry and season the salmon
steps.text: Pat the salmon very dry with kitchen paper, especially the skin. Season both sides with salt and pepper and leave at room temperature for 10 minutes.
steps.visual: Two pink salmon fillets, skin side up, on a plate, patted dry and sprinkled with salt and cracked pepper

steps.title: Sear skin-side down
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Lay the salmon in skin-side down, press gently for 10 seconds, then cook without moving for 4 to 5 minutes until the skin is crisp and the flesh is opaque two-thirds of the way up.
steps.visual: Salmon fillets skin-side down in a black non-stick pan, the sides turning pale opaque from the bottom up, oil sizzling

steps.title: Flip and finish
steps.text: Flip the fillets and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more until just cooked in the centre. Move to a plate, skin up.
steps.visual: Seared salmon fillets on a plate showing golden crisp skin on top and a pink, just-cooked edge

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: In the same pan, add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons of water, cover and cook on medium heat for 3 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
steps.visual: Bright green broccoli florets steaming in the pan with the lid just lifted

steps.title: Wilt the spinach
steps.text: Add the garlic and spinach and toss for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach just wilts. Season lightly and divide between two plates.
steps.visual: Wilted dark green spinach and broccoli with golden garlic slices in the pan

steps.title: Make the lemon butter
steps.text: Lower the heat, add the butter to the empty pan and let it melt and foam. Off the heat, stir in the lemon juice and dill.
steps.visual: Foaming golden lemon butter flecked with chopped green dill in the pan

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Set the salmon on the greens and spoon over the lemon butter. Serve straight away.
steps.visual: A crisp-skinned salmon fillet on a bed of wilted spinach and broccoli, glossy lemon–dill butter spooned over, a lemon wedge on the plate

substitutions.note: Seer fish steaks are cheaper and widely available; cook 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Ghee gives a nutty finish and doesn't burn as easily.
Parsley or coriander work if dill (suva) isn't available.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; leftover salmon keeps 1 day in the fridge.
recipes.reheating: Warm gently in a low oven or flake cold into a salad — high heat dries salmon out.

recipes.title: Tuna, Corn and Cucumber Salad
recipes.description: Flaked canned tuna mixed with crunchy celery, cucumber, onion and sweet corn in a light hung-curd and mustard dressing, served over crisp lettuce.

steps.title: Flake the tuna
steps.text: Drain the tuna well, pressing out the water, and flake it into a mixing bowl with a fork.
steps.visual: Flaked pale pink tuna in a steel mixing bowl, an open drained can beside it

steps.title: Cook the corn
steps.text: Boil the corn in a small saucepan of water for 3 minutes, drain and cool.
steps.visual: Bright yellow corn kernels draining in a small steel strainer

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Finely chop the onion and celery and dice the cucumber.
steps.visual: Finely chopped onion, pale green celery and cucumber dice on a wooden board

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: In a small bowl stir together the hung curd, mayonnaise, mustard sauce, lemon juice, black pepper and a pinch of salt.
steps.visual: A small bowl of thick, creamy pale-yellow mustard yogurt dressing with pepper flecks

steps.title: Fold the tuna salad
steps.text: Add the corn, chopped vegetables and dressing to the tuna and fold gently until combined.
steps.visual: Creamy tuna salad with yellow corn, cucumber, celery and onion folded through in the steel bowl

steps.title: Dress the leaves
steps.text: Toss the lettuce with the olive oil and a pinch of salt and divide between two plates.
steps.visual: Glossy torn lettuce leaves arranged on two white plates

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile the tuna salad onto the lettuce and serve chilled.
steps.visual: A mound of creamy tuna, corn and cucumber salad on a bed of green lettuce, cracked pepper on top

substitutions.note: Use all hung curd for a lighter, egg-free dressing.
Finely diced capsicum gives the same crunch.
Use poached, shredded chicken breast instead of tuna.

recipes.storage: Keeps 1 day in the fridge; keep the lettuce separate.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.description: Tender chicken meatballs bound with oats, egg, parsley and parmesan, baked instead of fried and simmered in a garlicky fresh tomato and basil sauce.

steps.title: Mix the meatballs
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. In a mixing bowl combine the chicken mince, egg, oat flour, grated onion, grated garlic, parsley, half the oregano, pepper, salt and parmesan. Mix with your hands until just combined — overmixing makes them dense.
steps.visual: Pale pink chicken mince mixture speckled with green parsley, oats and grated parmesan in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Shape the meatballs
steps.text: Brush a baking tray with 1 teaspoon of the olive oil. With wet hands, roll the mixture into 18 walnut-sized balls and space them out on the tray.
steps.visual: Eighteen evenly rolled raw chicken meatballs lined up on an oiled baking tray

steps.title: Bake the meatballs
steps.text: Bake at 200°C for 15 to 18 minutes until golden and firm. In an air fryer, cook at 190°C for 12 minutes, shaking halfway.
steps.visual: Golden-brown baked chicken meatballs on the baking tray, lightly crisp on top

steps.title: Start the sauce
steps.text: Meanwhile heat the remaining olive oil in a wide saucepan over medium heat. Cook the chopped onion and sliced garlic for 4 minutes until soft.
steps.visual: Softened chopped onion and sliced garlic glistening in olive oil in a wide steel saucepan

steps.title: Simmer the tomatoes
steps.text: Add the puréed tomato, chilli flakes, the remaining oregano and a pinch of salt. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring, until thickened.
steps.visual: A thick, bubbling bright red tomato sauce in the saucepan with flecks of chilli and oregano

steps.title: Simmer meatballs in sauce
steps.text: Add the baked meatballs to the sauce, turn to coat and simmer on low heat for 5 minutes so they soak up the flavour.
steps.visual: Golden chicken meatballs nestled in thick red tomato sauce in the saucepan, gently bubbling

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with torn basil and serve with whole-wheat pasta, zucchini noodles or a slice of whole-wheat toast.
steps.visual: Chicken meatballs in red tomato sauce in a shallow bowl, topped with torn green basil leaves

substitutions.note: Use 1½ slices of bread soaked in water and squeezed instead of oats.
Mutton mince makes richer meatballs; bake 2 to 3 minutes longer.
Parsley works as a garnish if basil isn't available.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate meatballs in sauce for up to 3 days, or freeze for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Reheat gently in a covered pan with a splash of water until piping hot.

recipes.title: Whole-Wheat Pasta Arrabbiata
recipes.description: Whole-wheat penne in a fiery, garlicky fresh-tomato sauce with chilli flakes and olive oil, finished with basil and a little parmesan.

steps.title: Grate the tomatoes
steps.text: Halve the tomatoes and grate the cut side on a box grater into a bowl until only the skin is left in your hand. Discard the skins.
steps.visual: A bowl of fresh grated tomato pulp with a box grater beside it and a few flat tomato skins discarded on the board

steps.title: Make the chilli-garlic oil
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a kadai or wide pan over low heat. Add the garlic and chilli flakes and cook gently for 2 minutes until the garlic is pale gold and the oil turns orange.
steps.visual: Pale golden garlic slices and red chilli flakes in orange-tinted olive oil in a wide black pan

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Add the grated tomato, oregano and a pinch of salt. Simmer on medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring, until thick and glossy.
steps.visual: A thick, glossy deep-red arrabbiata sauce bubbling in the wide pan, garlic slices visible

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.text: Meanwhile bring the water to a rolling boil in a large saucepan with the remaining salt. Cook the pasta for 10 to 11 minutes (or as the pack says) until just tender. Save half a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
steps.visual: Brown whole-wheat penne tumbling in a large saucepan of rolling boiling water

steps.title: Toss pasta and sauce
steps.text: Add the drained pasta to the sauce with a splash of the pasta water and toss over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce clings to every piece.
steps.visual: Penne coated in glossy red arrabbiata sauce being tossed in the wide pan

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide between two plates, scatter with torn basil and grated parmesan and serve hot.
steps.visual: A plate of whole-wheat penne arrabbiata with red sauce, fresh basil leaves and a dusting of grated parmesan

substitutions.note: Toss the sauce with 400 g zucchini noodles for a lighter, lower-carb version.
Leave the cheese out for a vegan plate.
Crush 3 to 4 dried red chillies instead of using flakes.

recipes.storage: The sauce keeps 4 days in the fridge; cooked pasta is best eaten fresh.
recipes.reheating: Reheat sauced pasta in a pan with a splash of water.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Chopped boiled eggs folded into a tangy hung curd and mustard dressing with spring onion, celery and dill, spooned into crisp lettuce leaves with tomato.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Put the eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water and bring to a boil. Lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes for firm yolks.
steps.visual: Six white eggs simmering in a steel saucepan of gently bubbling water

steps.title: Cool and peel
steps.text: Move the eggs to a bowl of cold water for 5 minutes, then crack and peel them. Chop roughly.
steps.visual: Peeled boiled eggs roughly chopped on a wooden board, firm yellow yolks showing, shells in a small heap

steps.title: Chop the herbs
steps.text: Finely slice the spring onion and chop the celery and dill.
steps.visual: Finely sliced spring onion, chopped pale green celery and feathery dill in small heaps on the board

steps.title: Mix the egg salad
steps.text: In a mixing bowl stir the hung curd, mustard sauce, lemon juice, pepper and salt. Fold in the chopped eggs, spring onion, celery and dill.
steps.visual: Chunky egg salad with white and yellow egg pieces, green spring onion and dill bound in a creamy dressing in a steel bowl

steps.title: Prepare the leaves
steps.text: Wash and dry the lettuce leaves and slice the tomato thinly.
steps.visual: Crisp, cupped lettuce leaves laid out on a platter beside thin red tomato slices

steps.title: Fill the wraps
steps.text: Lay a tomato slice in each lettuce leaf, spoon in the egg salad and dust with a pinch of Kashmiri chilli.
steps.visual: Lettuce cups each holding a tomato slice and a mound of creamy egg salad, dusted with red chilli

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight away, folding each leaf around the filling to eat.
steps.visual: Egg salad lettuce wraps arranged on a white platter, creamy filling with red chilli dust and green herbs peeking out

substitutions.note: Finely diced cucumber gives a similar crunch.
Coriander gives an Indian-leaning flavour.
Use half the amount of mayonnaise for a richer, classic egg salad.

recipes.storage: The egg salad keeps 2 days in the fridge; fill the lettuce just before eating.

recipes.title: Thai-Style Peanut Chicken with Vegetables
recipes.description: Seared chicken thigh strips and crunchy red pepper, broccoli and carrot tossed in a creamy peanut, coconut milk, lime and ginger sauce, topped with crushed peanuts.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken strips with 1 teaspoon of the soy sauce and half the garlic and leave for 10 minutes.
steps.visual: Thin chicken thigh strips glossy with soy sauce and grated garlic in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Whisk the peanut sauce
steps.text: In a bowl whisk the peanut butter, coconut milk, the remaining soy sauce and garlic, lemon juice, honey, chilli flakes, ginger and water until smooth and pourable.
steps.visual: A smooth, creamy tan peanut sauce with red chilli flecks in a small bowl, a whisk resting in it

steps.title: Cut the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the pepper into strips, the broccoli into small florets and the carrot into thin batons. Slice the spring onion.
steps.visual: Red pepper strips, small broccoli florets, orange carrot batons and sliced spring onion on a wooden board

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Heat the oil in a kadai over high heat. Add the chicken in a single layer and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Lift out.
steps.visual: Browned chicken strips sizzling in a black kadai, edges caramelised

steps.title: Stir-fry the vegetables
steps.text: In the same kadai, stir-fry the broccoli and carrot with 2 tablespoons of water for 2 minutes, then add the pepper and spring onion whites for 1 minute more.
steps.visual: Bright green broccoli, orange carrot and red pepper strips tossed in the steaming kadai

steps.title: Simmer in peanut sauce
steps.text: Return the chicken, pour in the peanut sauce and simmer on medium heat for 2 minutes, stirring, until thick and coating everything. Loosen with a splash of water if needed.
steps.visual: Chicken and colourful vegetables coated in a thick, glossy tan peanut sauce bubbling in the kadai

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with crushed peanuts, spring onion greens and coriander. Serve with brown rice or cauliflower rice.
steps.visual: Peanut chicken with vegetables in a white bowl, scattered with crushed peanuts, spring onion and coriander, a lime wedge on the side

substitutions.note: Use pressed firm tofu, pan-fried until golden, for a vegetarian version.
A little grated jaggery gives the same gentle sweetness.
Toned milk works if you don't have coconut milk; the sauce will be lighter.

recipes.storage: Keeps 2 days in the fridge.
recipes.reheating: Reheat in a pan with a splash of water — the peanut sauce thickens as it cools.

recipes.title: Japanese-Style Rolled Egg and Vegetable Omelette
recipes.description: A tamagoyaki-inspired omelette built in thin layers and rolled into a log, lightly sweet-savoury with soy and flecked with carrot, spinach and spring onion.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.text: Finely slice the spring onion, grate the carrot and shred the spinach very thinly so they don't tear the egg layers.
steps.visual: Small heaps of finely sliced spring onion, grated orange carrot and thinly shredded spinach on a wooden board

steps.title: Whisk the eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the soy sauce, sugar, water and pepper until the whites and yolks are fully combined but not frothy.
steps.visual: A smooth, evenly yellow egg mixture in a steel mixing bowl with a whisk resting against the rim

steps.title: Fold in the vegetables
steps.text: Stir the vegetables into the egg mixture.
steps.visual: Yellow egg mixture speckled with orange carrot, green spinach and spring onion in the steel bowl

steps.title: Cook the first layer
steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and brush with a little sesame oil. Pour in about a quarter of the egg, tilt to coat thinly and cook for about 1 minute until almost set. Roll it up from one side towards you into a loose log.
steps.visual: A thin, nearly set layer of vegetable-flecked egg in a non-stick pan being rolled into a log with a spatula

steps.title: Build up the layers
steps.text: Push the log to the far side, brush the pan with oil and pour in another quarter of the egg, lifting the log so egg flows underneath. When almost set, roll the log back over the new layer. Repeat until all the egg is used, about 6 minutes in all.
steps.visual: A thick, layered golden egg roll in the pan with a fresh thin sheet of egg spread out in front of it, ready to be rolled

steps.title: Rest and shape
steps.text: Turn the roll out onto a board, press it gently into a neat rectangle with a clean cloth and rest for 2 minutes so the layers set.
steps.visual: A neat golden rectangular egg roll resting on a wooden board, a cloth folded beside it

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.text: Slice into 2-cm pieces to show the layers, sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve warm or at room temperature.
steps.visual: Thick slices of rolled omelette showing spiral layers flecked with carrot and spinach, sprinkled with sesame seeds on a white plate

substitutions.note: Any neutral oil works for greasing the pan.
A tiny pinch of stevia keeps the slight sweetness without sugar — or simply leave it out.

recipes.storage: Keeps 1 day in the fridge; good cold in lunch boxes.
recipes.reheating: Eat at room temperature or warm for 20 seconds in the microwave.

recipes.title: Korean-Style Spicy Glazed Tofu
recipes.description: Crisp pan-fried tofu slabs coated in a sticky, garlicky chilli glaze — Kashmiri chilli stands in for gochugaru — with sesame and spring onion.

steps.title: Press the tofu
steps.text: Wrap the tofu in a kitchen towel and press under a heavy pan for 15 minutes, then cut into 1-cm slabs.
steps.visual: Pressed tofu cut into neat rectangular slabs on a wooden board, a damp kitchen towel beside them

steps.title: Mix the chilli glaze
steps.text: In a small bowl stir together the garlic, ginger, Kashmiri chilli, chilli flakes, soy sauce, honey, vinegar and water.
steps.visual: A small bowl of thin, brick-red chilli glaze with flecks of garlic and ginger

steps.title: Dust the tofu
steps.text: Dust the tofu slabs on all sides with the cornflour, tapping off the excess.
steps.visual: Tofu slabs lightly coated in white cornflour on a steel plate

steps.title: Pan-fry until crisp
steps.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and crisp. Lift onto a plate.
steps.visual: Golden, crisp tofu slabs in a wide black non-stick pan, a few flipped to show the browned side

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Add the onion to the same pan and cook for 2 minutes on medium heat until just soft.
steps.visual: Thinly sliced onion softening in the pan with a little leftover oil

steps.title: Glaze the tofu
steps.text: Pour in the chilli glaze and let it bubble for 1 to 2 minutes until sticky. Return the tofu, add the sesame oil and toss gently until every slab is coated.
steps.visual: Crisp tofu slabs and onion coated in a glossy, sticky red chilli glaze in the pan

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onion and serve hot with brown rice or a crunchy slaw.
steps.visual: Glossy red glazed tofu slabs on a white plate scattered with sesame seeds and diagonal slices of spring onion

substitutions.note: Use sugar to keep the dish vegan.
Paneer slabs work well; no pressing needed.

recipes.storage: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; the coating softens.
recipes.reheating: Reheat in a hot pan for 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Rajma and Corn Salsa Salad
recipes.description: A Mexican-style bean salad of firm-cooked rajma and tawa-charred corn with tomato, onion, capsicum, green chilli and coriander in a lime–cumin dressing.

steps.title: Soak the rajma
steps.text: Soak the rajma in plenty of water for 8 hours or overnight.
steps.visual: Dark red kidney beans plump after soaking in a steel bowl of water

steps.title: Cook the rajma firm
steps.text: Drain and pressure-cook with the water and a pinch of salt on medium heat for 18 minutes (about 5 whistles). The beans should be cooked through but still whole — check one by pressing.
steps.visual: Whole, glossy cooked kidney beans holding their shape in the opened pressure cooker

steps.title: Drain and cool
steps.text: Drain the beans and spread them out to cool for 15 minutes.
steps.visual: Drained red kidney beans spread over a wide steel plate to cool

steps.title: Char the corn
steps.text: Heat a dry tawa over high heat and toast the corn for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring now and then, until spotted with brown — like a roadside bhutta.
steps.visual: Yellow corn kernels with dark charred spots on a hot black tawa

steps.title: Chop the salsa vegetables
steps.text: Dice the tomato and capsicum, finely chop the onion and green chilli, and chop the coriander.
steps.visual: Diced red tomato and green capsicum, chopped onion, green chilli and coriander in piles on a wooden board

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: In a large mixing bowl whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, roasted cumin, Kashmiri chilli and a pinch of salt.
steps.visual: A reddish-gold lime, cumin and chilli dressing at the bottom of a large steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Toss the salad
steps.text: Add the rajma, charred corn and chopped vegetables and toss well. Rest for 10 minutes so the beans soak up the dressing.
steps.visual: Red kidney beans, charred yellow corn, tomato, capsicum, onion and coriander tossed together in the steel bowl

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve at room temperature on its own, with lettuce leaves, or topped with a spoon of guacamole.
steps.visual: A colourful rajma and corn salsa salad heaped in a shallow bowl, red beans and yellow corn with green coriander, a lemon wedge alongside

substitutions.note: Black chickpeas make a nuttier, cheaper salad.
Any neutral oil works in the dressing.

recipes.storage: Keeps 3 days in the fridge — add the coriander fresh if making ahead.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush (Smoky Brinjal Dip)
recipes.description: Large brinjal charred directly over the gas flame as for bharta, then mashed with tahini, garlic, lemon and cumin into a silky, smoky Levantine dip.

steps.title: Prick the brinjal
steps.text: Wash and dry the brinjal and prick it all over with a fork so it doesn't burst while charring.
steps.visual: A large, glossy purple bharta brinjal on a board with tiny fork holes across its skin

steps.title: Char over the flame
steps.text: Place the brinjal directly on a gas flame over high heat and roast for 15 to 20 minutes, turning with tongs, until the skin is black and the whole brinjal has collapsed. Without a gas stove, roast in the oven at 220°C for 35 to 40 minutes.
steps.visual: A blackened, blistered, collapsed brinjal sitting directly on a gas burner flame, wisps of smoke rising

steps.title: Steam, peel and drain
steps.text: Put the hot brinjal in a covered bowl for 10 minutes so the skin loosens. Peel off the charred skin, then let the flesh drain in a sieve for a few minutes to remove bitter juices.
steps.visual: Soft, smoky golden-brown brinjal flesh draining in a steel sieve, flakes of charred skin on a plate beside

steps.title: Mash with tahini
steps.text: Chop the flesh roughly and mash in a mixing bowl with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, salt and cumin until creamy but still a little textured.
steps.visual: A creamy, pale smoky-beige brinjal and tahini dip being mashed with a fork in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spread in a shallow bowl, drizzle with olive oil and top with parsley, a pinch of Kashmiri chilli and pomegranate arils if you have them. Serve with vegetable sticks or whole-wheat toast.
steps.visual: Smoky baba ganoush in a shallow bowl with a golden olive oil drizzle, green parsley, a dusting of red chilli and ruby pomegranate arils

substitutions.note: Use 60 g hung curd instead of tahini for a lighter, tangier dip.
Coriander or mint make a good garnish.

recipes.storage: Keeps 3 days in the fridge in an airtight box.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Chickpea and Vegetable Stew
recipes.description: A warming one-pot stew of chickpeas, sweet potato, carrot and zucchini in a tomato base spiced with cumin, coriander, cinnamon and chilli, with a few raisins for sweetness.

steps.title: Soak the chickpeas
steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in plenty of water for 8 hours or overnight.
steps.visual: Swollen beige chickpeas soaking in a large steel bowl of water

steps.title: Pressure-cook the chickpeas
steps.text: Drain and pressure-cook with 2 cups of the water and a pinch of salt on medium heat for 15 minutes (about 4 whistles) until tender. Keep the cooking liquid.
steps.visual: Tender cooked chickpeas in their cooking liquid in an opened pressure cooker

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.text: Chop the onion, garlic and tomatoes, grate the ginger, cut the carrot into thick rounds, the sweet potato into cubes and the zucchini into chunks.
steps.visual: Chopped onion, garlic, grated ginger, chopped tomato, carrot rounds, orange sweet potato cubes and zucchini chunks on a wooden board

steps.title: Sauté the aromatics
steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a heavy kadai over medium heat. Cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
steps.visual: Softened golden onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil in a heavy black kadai

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.text: Lower the heat and add the cumin, coriander powder, cinnamon, Kashmiri chilli and turmeric. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
steps.visual: Onions coated in rust-red and golden spices with a cinnamon stick in the kadai

steps.title: Cook the tomatoes
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes until they soften into a thick sauce.
steps.visual: A thick, spiced red tomato base bubbling in the kadai

steps.title: Simmer the root vegetables
steps.text: Add the carrot, sweet potato and raisins, then the chickpeas with their liquid and the remaining water. Cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the sweet potato is almost tender.
steps.visual: Chickpeas, carrot rounds, sweet potato cubes and plump raisins simmering in a brothy red stew in the covered kadai, lid ajar

steps.title: Add the zucchini
steps.text: Stir in the zucchini and simmer uncovered for 6 minutes until tender and the stew has thickened. Taste for salt.
steps.visual: A thick, chunky orange-red stew with chickpeas, sweet potato, carrot and green zucchini in the kadai

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Remove the cinnamon stick, stir in the lemon juice and top with coriander. Serve hot on its own or with a little quinoa.
steps.visual: Moroccan chickpea and vegetable stew in a deep earthenware bowl, chunky with sweet potato, carrot and zucchini, topped with fresh coriander

substitutions.note: Red pumpkin makes a lighter, lower-carb stew; add it with the zucchini.
Chopped dates give the same gentle sweetness — or leave them out.
Kidney beans work too; cook them 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.storage: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes well for 1 month.
recipes.reheating: Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until bubbling.

recipes.title: Middle-Eastern Chicken Kebabs with Garlic Yogurt
recipes.description: Lemon, garlic and warm-spice marinated chicken skewers with capsicum and onion, grilled until charred and served with a cool garlic–mint yogurt.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.text: In a mixing bowl combine the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander powder, Kashmiri chilli, pepper, oregano and salt. Add the chicken cubes and mix well.
steps.visual: Chicken cubes coated in a glossy orange-red spiced lemon and garlic marinade in a steel mixing bowl

steps.title: Rest to marinate
steps.text: Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour, or up to 6 hours. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water now.
steps.visual: The covered steel bowl of marinated chicken on a fridge shelf, wooden skewers soaking in a tray of water beside it

steps.title: Cut the vegetables
steps.text: Cut the capsicum into squares and separate the onion into petals about the size of the chicken cubes.
steps.visual: Green capsicum squares and onion petals in two piles on a wooden board

steps.title: Thread the skewers
steps.text: Thread the chicken onto skewers, alternating with capsicum and onion. Leave a little space between pieces so they char evenly.
steps.visual: Six skewers threaded with orange marinated chicken, green capsicum and white onion petals on a tray

steps.title: Grill until charred
steps.text: Air fry at 200°C for 12 to 14 minutes, turning halfway, or cook on a hot grill pan or tawa over medium-high heat for 12 minutes, turning every 3 minutes, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
steps.visual: Chicken kebab skewers with charred edges and blistered capsicum on a hot ridged grill pan

steps.title: Make the garlic yogurt
steps.text: Stir the hung curd with the grated garlic, mint, lemon juice and a pinch of salt until smooth.
steps.visual: A bowl of thick white garlic yogurt flecked with chopped green mint

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the kebabs hot with the garlic yogurt, alongside tabbouleh, a cucumber salad or a small portion of brown rice.
steps.visual: Charred chicken kebabs on a platter beside a bowl of minty garlic yogurt, a green salad and lemon wedges

substitutions.note: Paneer cubes need just 8 to 10 minutes and a 30-minute marinade.
Thigh stays juicier on the grill.
Use regular curd for a runnier sauce.

recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked kebabs for up to 3 days; the yogurt keeps 2 days.
recipes.reheating: Reheat in the air fryer at 180°C for 4 minutes or in a hot pan.

recipes.title: Caprese-Style Tomato and Mozzarella Salad
recipes.description: Thick slices of ripe tomato and soft mozzarella layered with fresh basil and finished with olive oil, a splash of vinegar and cracked black pepper. Ready in ten minutes.

steps.title: Slice and salt the tomatoes
steps.text: Slice the tomatoes 1 cm thick, sprinkle lightly with salt and leave for 5 minutes so they release a little juice and taste sweeter.
steps.visual: Thick red tomato slices laid out on a wooden board with a light sprinkle of salt glistening on top

steps.title: Slice the mozzarella
steps.text: Pat the mozzarella dry and cut it into slices the same thickness as the tomato.
steps.visual: Soft white mozzarella slices on the board beside the tomato slices

steps.title: Layer with basil
steps.text: On a platter, arrange the tomato and mozzarella slices in overlapping alternating rows, tucking a basil leaf between each.
steps.visual: Overlapping rows of red tomato and white mozzarella slices with bright green basil leaves tucked between them on a white platter

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Drizzle the olive oil and vinegar over the platter and finish with plenty of cracked black pepper.
steps.visual: The tomato–mozzarella platter glistening with a golden drizzle of olive oil and specks of black pepper

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight away at room temperature, alongside grilled chicken, soup or whole-wheat toast.
steps.visual: A caprese-style platter of alternating tomato and mozzarella slices with basil, olive oil and pepper, a small bowl of soup beside

substitutions.note: Soft, fresh malai paneer slices make a milder, more affordable version.
A squeeze of lemon works in place of vinegar.

recipes.storage: Best eaten fresh; don't refrigerate the assembled salad, as cold tomatoes turn mealy.

recipes.title: Asian-Style Cabbage and Carrot Slaw
recipes.description: Finely shredded cabbage, carrot and red pepper tossed in a tangy soy, vinegar, ginger and sesame dressing, topped with crushed roasted peanuts and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Shred the vegetables
steps.text: Shred the cabbage as finely as you can, julienne the carrot, cut the pepper into thin strips and slice the spring onion. Chop the coriander.
steps.visual: Fine pale-green cabbage shreds, orange carrot matchsticks, red pepper strips, sliced spring onion and chopped coriander on a wooden board

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.text: In a large mixing bowl whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, lemon juice, honey, sesame oil, ginger and green chilli until the honey dissolves.
steps.visual: A thin, glossy brown dressing with flecks of grated ginger and green chilli in a large steel mixing bowl, a whisk beside

steps.title: Toss the slaw
steps.text: Add all the shredded vegetables and herbs to the bowl and toss thoroughly with your hands or tongs so every strand is coated.
steps.visual: Colourful shredded cabbage, carrot and red pepper glistening with dressing being tossed with tongs in the steel bowl

steps.title: Rest briefly
steps.text: Leave the slaw for 10 minutes so the cabbage softens slightly and absorbs the dressing.
steps.visual: The dressed slaw resting in the steel bowl, the cabbage slightly wilted and shiny

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.text: Pile into a serving bowl and scatter with crushed peanuts and sesame seeds just before serving so they stay crunchy.
steps.visual: A heaped bowl of bright Asian slaw — pale green cabbage, orange carrot and red pepper — topped with crushed peanuts and white sesame seeds

substitutions.note: Use sugar to keep the slaw vegan.
Roasted cashews work for a peanut-free slaw.
Green capsicum is cheaper and just as crunchy.

recipes.storage: Undressed shredded vegetables keep 2 days in the fridge; dressed slaw is best within a few hours.
